expected_behavior: renders with agg using an explicit theme and sensible defaults (font size, fps cap, idle limit)
optimizes with gifsicle (-O3, --lossy and/or --colors) and reports final size against the 10 MB GitHub image budget

cases.prompt: I need an mp4 of the recording for the release notes
expected_behavior: renders cast to gif with agg, then converts with ffmpeg using yuv420p pixel format, even-dimension scale filter, and +faststart
verifies the mp4 was produced (e.g. ffprobe/file) and notes it is silent video
explains GitHub renders uploaded mp4 attachments click-to-play (10 MB free / 100 MB paid), while gifs autoplay inline

cases.prompt: Only the part between the build and the test run matters - render just that, a bit faster
expected_behavior: uses agg --select with a time range (or markers) to trim, plus --speed and --idle-time-limit for pacing
does not modify the source .cast - trimming happens at render time

cases.prompt: Match the rendered gif to our brand palette instead of a stock theme
expected_behavior: passes a custom agg theme as comma-separated hex values (background, foreground, then 8 or 16 palette colors)
falls back to a neutral built-in theme (e.g. github-dark) when no palette is provided
optionally pairs dark/light renders via the <picture> prefers-color-scheme pattern for README theme-awareness
